system.description: As an action, infuse your Chakra into water, causing it to come to life as a tendril. When you first perform this ability and as an action each turn afterwards you may perform a Ninjutsu attack with the water against a target within five yards of both you and the water. Should you successfully land the attack you may either grab the target with the manipulated water or deal 3 + Arcane Might blunt damage. A target grabbed by this tendril may attempt to break free with a Strength + Agility roll against a fresh Ninjutsu roll. You may not reinforce the grapple with this tendril, but you may crush the target to deal 3 + Arcane Might blunt damage without requiring a roll. This ability lasts for a minute.
